name: Cappuccino Jones
profileSummary: Cappuccino Jones is an American professional wrestler. As of November 2024, he is signed to WWE, where he is part of the WWE ID program and performs on the Evolve brand. He is a former one-time and inaugural WWE ID Champion. He has also made appearances for All Elite Wrestling (AEW), Ring of Honor (ROH), and Game Changer Wrestling (GCW). He also makes appearances for Core Professional Wrestling (CPW), where he is the CPW 918 Champion.
